sloka: स तं समाविध्य सहस्रशः कपिर्महोरगं गृह्य इवाण्डजेश्वरः ।मुमोच वेगात् पितृतुल्यविक्रमो महीतले संयति वानरोत्तमः ।। ५.४७.३५।।।।
transliteration: sa taṁ samāvidhya sahasraśaḥ kapirmahoragaṁ gṛhya ivāṇḍajeśvaraḥ ।mumoca vegāt pitṛtulyavikramo mahītale saṁyati vānarottamaḥ ।। 5.47.35।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the foremost of the vanaras who was equal to his father in valour, seized him just as Garuda, the lord of birds, would seize a great serpent. And spinning him round speedily a thousand times and hitting him, dropped him on the earth.
translations.hindi: उसे तुम सारी लंका का नाश करने वाली कालरात्रि समझो । बस, थब तुम सीतारूपी काल की फाँसी को
